diagnosis: The CI/CD build streaming endpoint reads output lines from the asyncio.Queue associated with task_id. It fails to check if current_user is a member of the repository or organization owning the build task, leaking source code logs, build artifacts, and environment variable secrets.
exploit_request:
GET /builds/worker-pool/task_runner_build_1092/logs HTTP/1.1
Host: cicd.corp.net
Authorization: Bearer <regular_dev_jwt>
